name: Backdrop Switch
hint: A backdrop change can trigger matching sequences and coordinate the scenes of a project.
instruction: Pair a backdrop change with a “when backdrop switches to” event when a scene transition should start follow-up actions.

examples.label: Example
examples.scratchblocks:
when green flag clicked
wait (1) seconds
switch backdrop to (backdrop1 v)

when backdrop switches to [backdrop1 v]
move (10) steps
